seoTitle: Writing Goal Tracker: Streaks from Your Word Count Log
metaDescription: Paste a log of dates and words written and see your daily goal streak, longest streak, average and project pace. Free and private.
intro: Paste a log of dates and words written, set a daily goal, and see your streak, longest streak, average and the days you hit the goal.
why:
Daily word-count goals work because streaks show. The hard part is keeping the numbers somewhere.

Paste a log with one line per day, set your goal and optionally a project total. The tool counts the current and longest streak, the share of days you hit the goal, averages and a projected finish at your recent pace. Nothing is stored by the page: you keep the log in your own notes and paste it back.
howTo: Paste the log and set your daily goal.
Optionally set today's date and a project target.
Read the streaks and the last days table.

faq.a: Nowhere. The page does not store anything, so keep the log in your own file.

faq.q: How is the current streak counted?
faq.a: Days in a row that met the goal, ending today if met, or yesterday if today is not over.

faq.q: What about days with no line?
